_doc.about: Your wait-loop-guard settings. Plugin updates never touch this file. Every value below is the default, so this file changes nothing until you edit it. Each list may also be a single string. The built-in rules always apply; these keys only add to them. Keys that start with _ are ignored.
_doc.escape_words: Extra escape comments. A command that contains any of them passes, like one with '# no-deadline-ok' (which keeps working). Example: ["# sem-prazo-ok"]
_doc.deadline_words: Extra words that count as a deadline, for example in your language. Each matches as a whole word, in any case. Example: ["prazo"]
_doc.deadline_patterns: Extra deadline patterns as Python regular expressions, matched as written (case-sensitive unless you add (?i)). An invalid one is skipped. Example: ["\\bLIMITE\\w*\\b"]
_doc.tip: A line added at the end of the message Claude sees when a loop is refused. Empty means no extra line.
